meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后,它会把你描述的 bug 变成一份英文 GitHub issue 或 PR,含复现步骤、根因分析、修复方案,并根据代码和运行日志决定提交到 LazyCodex 还是上游 Codex 的仓库。
howto.when: 当你说要报告、提交、打开或分类 LazyCodex、Codex CLI、Codex 插件等 bug 时触发,尤其是需要定位根因和复现步骤时。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 提一个 bug issue
say.note: 它会先调查源码和运行证据再提交。

say.text: 分析这个 Codex CLI 报错,生成修复 PR
say.note: 仅当问题属于上游 Codex 时才会创建 PR。

say.text: 这是 omo-codex 的 bug,帮我 triage 并写出根因
say.note: 会定位到负责的仓库并生成 issue。

howto.what_en: This skill turns a bug report into an English GitHub issue or PR containing reproduction, root cause, and fix proposal, and routes it to the right repo based on source and runtime evidence.
howto.when_en: Trigger when the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, Codex CLI, Codex plugin, etc., especially when they need root cause and reproduction steps.

say_en.text: File a bug issue for LazyCodex for me.
say_en.note: It investigates sources and runtime evidence first.

say_en.text: Analyze this Codex CLI error and create a fix PR.
say_en.note: Only creates a PR if the bug belongs to upstream Codex.

say_en.text: This is an omo-codex bug; please triage it and find root cause.
say_en.note: It will locate the owning repo and generate an issue.
